AI Avatar Disappointment. Over all I am disappointed with the images produced by this app. I tried a couple of tools provided in this app. Nothing separated the product produced in this app from cheaper apps. After playing around with the art tools, I decided to test the avatar creator. I purchased the AI Avatar 100 pack. Picture quality was acceptable but unremarkable and lacked the variety produced by most other apps. My main issue with this app is that the images produced by the AI Avatar 100 pack were exactly the same as the avatars produced by separate app I used more than six months ago. There was no info in the app description or app store that linked the apps. With no indicators of the two apps being created or sold by the same company It didn’t cross my mind that the images produced would be the same as a separate app. I am still unsure if the two apps were created by the same company or if the two apps are unaffiliated but use the same AI software. Either way it’s an issue that will greatly impact my decision to purchase additional products from this AI app and others.

That value is not priced anywhere near its current capability. 

For me one star reviews are reserved for the truly abysmal such as non-working, completely obnoxious apps.
